description_en: Queries whether Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium is authorized to access other cloud services
description_zh: 查询是否授权DDoS高防服务访问其他云产品
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-sts-grant-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --role AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStsGrantStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM role to query. Set the value to AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole, which indicates the default role of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.

Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium uses the default role to access other cloud services
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的RAM角色名称。取值固定为AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole，表示DDoS高防服务的默认角色。

DDoS高防服务默认使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源
parameters.name: role
